title: Manuals
summary: What works for this person in one situation, written up by the coach as a page.

requirements.text: Apart from MAN-2, only an index of manuals rides in the coach's prompt, and the coach reads a manual with a tool when it applies.

history.text: Only an index of manuals rides in the coach's prompt; the coach reads a manual when it applies.

requirements.text: A manual tied to a situation the app can see (a running fast) is given to the coach in full while that situation holds.
The user can edit a manual.

history.text: The user can edit a manual, and the coach keeps the user's words as written.
history.reason: Version 1 also promised the coach keeps the user's words, which is a prompt instruction only; that is now MAN-5.

requirements.text: Every edit of a manual's title or body keeps the version it replaced.

history.text: Every change to a manual keeps the version it replaced.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: changes to which situation a manual applies to are not kept, and deletion removes the history.

history.text: Every edit of a manual's title or body keeps the version it replaced; deleting a manual deletes its history.
history.reason: Version 2 held two promises; what deleting does is now MAN-6.

requirements.text: The coach is instructed to keep the user's own edits to a manual as written.
Deleting a manual deletes its kept versions with it.
